name: faulty-toolhead-3
title: Faulty Toolhead 3 Bypass
author: bespoked
description: Temporary recovery override for Snapmaker U1 error 0003-0523-0000-0002 when toolhead 3's thermistor is damaged and blocks boot. Remaps [extruder2] sensor_pin to e2:PC5, raises max_temp and drops max_power so the dead sensor is ignored, and neutralizes the e2_nozzle_fan nozzle fan. Do not heat or print with toolhead 3 while this is enabled; disable it once the part is replaced. Per-toolhead and independent, so several can be enabled at once.
tagline: Boot the U1 with a damaged toolhead 3 thermistor.
